% Pattern: head/command. The paper writes each head with a command of its own
% and no environment: the command steps a counter and writes the title in
% bold, and a proof command writes "Proof" in italic. The heads print the
% values of their counters, 1.1 each. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want head-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want head-2 proof - proves=head-1
% want head-3 definition 1.1
\documentclass{article}
\newcounter{lemma}[section]
\renewcommand{\thelemma}{{Lemma \thesection.\arabic{lemma}}}
\newcommand{\lemma}{%
     \refstepcounter{lemma}
     {\bf \thelemma:\ }}
\newcounter{definition}[section]
\renewcommand{\thedefinition}{{Definition \thesection.\arabic{definition}}}
\newcommand{\definition}{%
     \refstepcounter{definition}
     {\bf \thedefinition:\ }}
\newcommand{\p}{{\em Proof}. }
\begin{document}
\section{One}
Some text before.

\lemma \label{one}
Every compact space is bounded.

\p Cover the space by balls. $\blacksquare$

\definition
A space is nice when it is compact.
\end{document}
